title: TIMELINE
lede: Every dated event in the archive, laid end to end. Late 2023 to October 2026: from three medalists and a demo video to a $40-billion conversation.
body:
h2. 2023 — THE QUIET YEAR

table(specs).
|_. when|_. event|
|late 2023|Scott Wu, Steven Hao, and Walden Yan — all IOI gold medalists — found Cognition in San Francisco|

h2. 2024 — THE DEMO YEAR

table(specs).
|_. when|_. event|
|early 2024|Founders Fund wires $21M at a $350M valuation|
|mar 12|%(ok)Devin unveiled% — 'the first AI software engineer'; 13.86% SWE-bench claim; interviews passed, Upwork jobs done|
|apr|Founders Fund leads $175M at $2B — unicorn in the first public quarter|
|mar–dec|early-access program runs; Devin mutates behind the curtain|
|dec 10|%(ok)Devin GA% — $500/mo, unlimited seats, Slack + IDE extension + API|

h2. 2025 — THE ACQUISITION YEAR

table(specs).
|_. when|_. event|
|mar|8VC-led round marks ~$4B valuation|
|spring|Devin pricing drops to a $20 Core tier — ACUs replace seats|
|apr 25|%(cyan)DeepWiki% opens — free AI wiki for every public GitHub repo|
|may 15|%(cyan)SWE-1 family% ships in Windsurf Wave 9 — SWE-1, -lite, -mini|
|may 22|DeepWiki MCP server ships|
|mid-year|%(cyan)Kevin-32B% — multi-turn RL CUDA kernel model, open weights|
|jun|Devin ARR reaches $73M (from $1M the previous September)|
|jul 11|Google's $2.4B reverse-acquihire guts Windsurf's leadership|
|jul 14|%(hl)Cognition acquires Windsurf% — signed over a single weekend|
|sep|$400M+ raise at $10.2B post-money; lifetime net burn still under $20M|
|oct 16|%(cyan)SWE-grep% — the context-retrieval specialist|
|oct 29|%(cyan)SWE-1.5% — 950 tok/s via Cerebras; the 'Falcon Alpha' mystery resolved|

h2. 2026 — THE FLAGSHIP YEAR

table(specs).
|_. when|_. event|
|early 2026|SWE-1.6 Preview published mid-run — +11% SWE-Bench Pro over 1.5|
|apr|%(cyan)SWE-1.6 GA% — 'model UX', free for three months|
|may|reported valuation reaches ~$26B|
|jun|%(amber)Windsurf renamed Devin Desktop% — one brand, two tempos|
|jul 8|%(cyan)SWE-1.7% — RL inside the Devin harness, Cerebras at 1000 TPS|
|aug|Bloomberg: fundraising talks at ≥$40B|
|sep 10|%(hl)SWE-2% — Kimi K3 base, multi-trillion RL, effort levels, FrontierCode 50.0%|
|oct|the annals you are reading are compiled by a dog and committed to the archive|
